text:
tara: Quick heads-up  team dinner with a prospective client last night. Corporate card was used for a single charge of $412.67 for 4 people. I misplaced one paper receipt (server said they lost it). I do have the merchant e-receipt and my card screenshot. Is this fine to submit? cc @finance :wave:
ben: since this is > $300 and entertainment, policy 4.1 says pre-approval is preferred but corp card use is allowed. We need manager approval + attendee list + business purpose. For the missing paper receipt upload the merchant e-receipt, card screenshot, and a signed attendee list explaining the missing stub. Tag EXCEPTION_PREAPP.
tara: okay uploading now. Merchant e-receipt shows itemization but no guest names. I'll recreate and sign the attendee list. Is an emailed guest list OK?
lisa: manager sign-off here  I approve this as legitimate business entertainment. Please include client company and attendee emails. :white_check_mark:
expense-bot: New expense submitted by tara  amount: 412.67 USD, tags: EXCEPTION_PREAPP, status: awaiting processing. Expense ID: EXP-2026-7788.
ben: Accounting note: entertainment > $250 needs client name + business reason for tax classification. We'll mark as entertain_non-deductible by default unless client event qualifies. Add the business purpose in the Expensify notes.
tara: uploaded merchant-email.pdf, card-statement.png, attendee-list-signed.pdf. Note: "Client: BrightPath Inc; attendees: Tara M., John P., Emily R., vendor rep; business reason: product demo + procurement discussion; missing paper receipt: server misplaced."
expense-bot: Expense EXP-2026-7788 updated  attachments received, awaiting final processing.
lisa: Approved and OK to reimburse. Ben, please process in next AP batch and flag for tax team.
ben: Will do. Processing and tagging for tax. Tara, expect reimbursement on next payroll run unless you request expedited ACH. :thumbsup:
tara: no rush, payroll is fine. Thanks everyone! :pray:
